paite: Huchiin Elipha Teman miin a dawng a, hichiin a chi a:
english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

paite: Mi pilin theihna bangmahlou toh dawnna a bawlin, suahlam huihin a gilpi a dimsak sak diam?
english: “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?

paite: Houlimna phatuamlou toh thu a ngaihtuahin, ahihkeileh hoih a hih theihna louh dinga thugente a ngaihtuah diam?
english: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good?

paite: A hi, launa na hihmanga, huan Pathian maa kipiakzohna na dal lai hi.
english: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.

paite: Na thulimlouhnain lah na kam a sinsaka, zekhemhat mi lei na tel ngal a.
english: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.

paite: Nang mahmah kamin nang siamlouh ahontang saka, kei hilouin; ahi, nang demin nangmah mukte mahmahin a hontheihpih hi.
english: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.

paite: A piang mihing masapen na hi ahia? ahihkeileh tangte maa lakkhiaka om na hi maw?
english: “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought forth before the hills?

paite: Pathian thuhilh guk na za ta hia? huan pilna na kikoih hoih hia?
english: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?

paite: Ka theih louh uh bang na theia? koua omlou bang na theisiama?
english: What do you know, that we don’t know? What do you understand, which is not in us?

paite: Ka lak uah samkang leh mi upa mahmah a om tuaktuak, na pa sanga nakpia upajawte.
english: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much elder than your father.

paite: Pathian nepnate leh siamtaka honhilh thute nang adia neu lua uhia?
english: Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?

paite: Bangdia na lungtangin nang honpi mang ahia? Bang dia na mitte phia ahia?
english: Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,

paite: Huchia Pathian dema na lungsim na heia, na kam akipana huchibang thute na pawtkhiak sak.
english: That you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?

paite: Mihing bang ahia, a sian ding? numei apan piang amah kua ahia a diktat ding?
english: What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

paite: Ngaiin, a mi siangthoute ah muanna a koih keia: ahi, a mitmuhin vante a siang kei uhi.
english: Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;

paite: Mi kihhuai leh sia, mi thulimlouhna tui banga dawn, nak sian keina semin chia:
english: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!

paite: Ka honensak ding, honja in; huan ka muhsa ka phuang ding:
english: “I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare:

paite: (Huai tuh mi pilten a pipute ua kipan na gen ua, a im kei uh;
english: (Which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it;

paite: Amau kiangah kia gam tuh piakin a oma, huan mikhual kuamah a lak uah a pai kei uh: )
english: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them):

paite: Mi gilouin a damsung ni tengin natna a thuaka, nuaisiahhatmi adia khawlkhawm kumte zah mahmah.
english: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.

paite: Launa ging a bil ah a oma; hauhlaiin lokmi a tungah a hongpai ding hi:
english: A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer shall come on him.

paite: Khomial akipan a hongkik ding chih a um keia, huan namsaua ngakin a om hi.
english: He doesn’t believe that he shall return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.

paite: Tanghou zongin a tamvaka, Koia om ahia? chiin. Khomial ni a kiang chinah mansain a om chih a theikei hi.
english: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

paite: Dahna leh haksatnain amah a lausaka; kumpipa galdou dia mansa bangin, amah a zou uhi.
english: Distress and anguish make him afraid. They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

paite: Pathian dou dinga a khut a likkhiak jiakin, Thilbangkimhihthei dou dinga kisathei taka a oma,
english: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty;

paite: A lum, a tuamna sahtaknei toh amah doua a tai teitei jiakin;
english: he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers;

paite: A thaua a maitang a khuha, a gila thau a kholkhawma,
english: because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.

paite: Khopi tulsaa a tena, kuamah ten tuak louhna inte, segawp ngiingei dingte a luah jiakin;
english: He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.

paite: A hau kei dinga, a neihlehlam a om gige kei dinga; amah leiah zung a kai kei ding;
english: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall their possessions be extended on the earth.

paite: Khomial akipan a suakta kei dinga, meikuangin a selnoute a kangkeu dinga, a paklunlaite huchin a mut mang ding.
english: He shall not depart out of darkness. The flame shall dry up his branches. By the breath of God’s mouth shall he go away.

paite: Amah kikhemin, banglou ah muang kei hen: bangmahlou lah a thukna hi ding ahi ngala.
english: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself; for emptiness shall be his reward.

paite: A hun main hihzohin a om dia, huan ahiang nou kei ding hi.
english: It shall be accomplished before his time. His branch shall not be green.

paite: Grepgui bangin a gah min lou a singpulh dia, oliv bangin a pak a pai khe ding.
english: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive tree.

paite: Pathianlimsaklou kithuahpihna lah hut ding ahia, golhna puaninte lah meiin kangmang ding ahi ngala.Siatna a pai ua, thulimlouhna a suakkhe sak uh, huan a lungtang un khemna a opkeuh uh.
english: For the company of the godless shall be barren, and fire shall consume the tents of bribery.

paite: Siatna a pai ua, thulimlouhna a suakkhe sak uh, huan a lungtang un khemna a opkeuh uh.
english: They conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”
